section: Skill development and employment in AP - AP State Skill Development Corporation, employment schemes
subsections: Government recruitment and village/ward secretariat employment

accepted.s: The Mega DSC-2025 in Andhra Pradesh recruited how many teachers and appointed how many police constables, respectively?
accepted.x: The Mega DSC-2025 recruited 15,941 teachers and 5,757 police constables were appointed.
accepted.tq: Split the paired figures carefully and match each number with its correct category.
accepted.sec: Government recruitment and village/ward secretariat employment

accepted.s: The upper age limit for government jobs in Andhra Pradesh has been raised to which age, and up to which year does this provision apply?
accepted.x: The upper age limit for government jobs has been raised to 44 years till 2027.
accepted.tq: Pair the age limit with the corresponding validity year instead of treating them as separate facts.
accepted.sec: Government recruitment and village/ward secretariat employment

accepted.s: Village and ward secretariats in Andhra Pradesh have been redesignated as which department?
o: Palle Pragathi and Ward Secretariat department
Grama Seva and Ward Development department
Swarna Andhra Village and Urban Services department
Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward department
accepted.x: Village and ward secretariats are now known as the Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward department.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official designation rather than a broad description of the institution.
accepted.sec: Government recruitment and village/ward secretariat employment

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the staff of village and ward secretariats in Andhra Pradesh:
1. They will act as Village Skill Officers.
2. They have mapped 1.68 crore households.
3. Their current staff strength has been officially specified as part of the available information.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Secretariat staff will act as Village Skill Officers and have mapped 1.68 crore households. The current staff strength is not specified.
accepted.tq: Find the unsupported statement; a precise numerical fact is combined with an unavailable detail.
accepted.sec: Government recruitment and village/ward secretariat employment

accepted.s: VB-G RAM G commenced in Andhra Pradesh on:
accepted.x: VB-G RAM G began on 1 July 2026 and was launched in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Use the exact commencement date and distinguish the year from nearby alternatives.

accepted.s: Which State has been reported as the top State on the iGOT Karmayogi platform, with more than one crore enrolments?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is the top State on iGOT Karmayogi, with over one crore enrolments.
accepted.tq: Use the location clue and connect the platform ranking with the enrolment figure.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about employment-related issues in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The unemployment allowance has remained unpaid.
2. Disputes have arisen over the DSC merit list.
3. Youth unemployment in the State is reported at 17.5%, which is above the national rate.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the unemployment allowance is unpaid, disputes concern the DSC merit list, and youth unemployment is 17.5%, above the national rate.
accepted.tq: Check each separately stated criticism and use the all-inclusive option only when every statement is supported.

accepted.s: Which of the following is the target under the Super Six programme of Andhra Pradesh regarding employment?
accepted.x: The Super Six target is to create 20 lakh jobs in five years.
accepted.tq: Match the employment target with its stated time period.
